subject: Executive alignment for Tectonix demo — VP/CTO presence and fallback plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@tectonix.com>, Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@tectonix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive alignment for Tectonix demo — VP/CTO presence and fallback plan

Hi Elaine and Daniel,

Thanks again for your time yesterday — excited about the pilot discussion. We're aiming to lock an executive-backed demo the week of July 3 so your leadership sees the high-level ROI and we can follow up with an engineering deep-dive. Two options that work on our side:

- Tue, Jul 4, 10:00–10:45 PT (internal exec window)
- Thu, Jul 6, 14:00–14:45 PT (alternate)

Is it possible to secure your VP of Product or CTO for a 30–45 minute executive walkthrough? The ask is mainly a 20-minute sponsor overview (value, use cases, risks) + 20-minute Q&A. If the exec can only join part of the time we can do a 15-minute handshake at the top and then continue into the technical session.

If exec attendance is uncertain, we propose this fallback so the meeting still delivers value:
- Start with a 15-minute executive touchpoint with your VP (if available) + redline the 30-minute technical demo to focus on the 3 integrations you care about.
- Priyom Das (AE) will be on the call as a backup exec liaison if scheduling conflicts arise.

I've attached a draft agenda and mutual action plan (MAP) for sequencing — please confirm what works and who should be invited.

Next steps: reply with preferred slot and confirm VP/CTO availability (or delegate). If neither exec can do those slots, give us two times next week and we'll hold both temporarily.

Best,

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf (PDF), Tectonix_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@tectonix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@tectonix.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 12:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Executive alignment for Tectonix demo — VP/CTO presence and fallback plan

Ben —

Appreciate the clear options and the MAP. Quick update from my side: VP of Product, Lena Park, can make the slot on Thu, Jul 6 at 14:00 PT (she's traveling early next week). Our CTO, Marco, is only available Wed Jul 5 in the morning (he's in APAC the week after).

Two asks from us:
1) Can you shorten the exec portion to 20 minutes? Lena prefers punchy executive summaries.
2) We have a standing engineering review from 14:30–15:30 ET on Jul 6; if Lena needs to drop at 14:40 ET that's OK as long as we get the top-level ask covered.

If Jul 6 at 14:00 PT works, we'll send a calendar hold and include a brief pre-read (one-pager) for Lena. If you'd prefer to try to get both Lena + Marco in the same session, we can also offer Jul 5 09:00 PT but Marco will need a tech-focused agenda (not high-level).

Best,
Elaine
Director, Product Operations | Tectonix
elaine.park@tectonix.com | 617-555-0199

Thanks Elaine — Jul 6 at 14:00 PT (Lena) works for us. We'll plan the agenda as a tight 20-minute sponsor overview + 20-minute targeted Q&A. I've made the following updates:

- Exec segment: 14:00–14:20 PT — VP sponsor overview (value, high-level outcomes, commitments)
- Technical segment: 14:20–14:45 PT — focused demo on the three integration points you flagged (auth, data pipeline, latency profile)

If Lena needs to drop at 14:10–14:15 PT, we'll capture the exec highlights up front and Priyom will surface commercial next steps and ask.

Action items from our side:
- Ben: finalize the 1-page pre-read for Lena and share by EOD Monday. (attached: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf)
- Priyom: prepare the high-level commercial slide and elevator ask.
- Marissa: FYI — would you like to join the call as backup sponsor?

Calendar: Ben will send the invite and tentatively hold Jul 6 14:00–14:45 PT. Please add Marco separately if you want to fold him into a parallel technical deep-dive on Jul 5 morning.

Thanks — looking forward.

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

1) Prioritize confirming Lena for the 14:00 PT slot and lock the calendar. If she can only do 10–15 minutes, that's fine — capture the VP ask (commitment/timeline) and the top risks.
